title: Creatio Releases The State of Enterprise AI Adoption Report: An In-Depth Look at Where Enterprise AI Stands | Creatio
description: The annual study of 600+ global IT and business leaders breaks down seven key trends in enterprise AI adoption.
text: October 20, 2026 Creatio Releases The State of Enterprise AI Adoption Report: An In-Depth Look at Where Enterprise AI Stands The annual study of 600+ global IT and business leaders breaks down seven key trends in enterprise AI adoption. Creatio, an AI CRM and workflow platform where people and AI agents work together, today released The State of Enterprise AI Adoption Report , its second annual study of how organizations are scaling AI and what sets the most advanced adopters apart. Based on a survey of 600+ global IT and business decision-makers, the research finds enterprise AI moving decisively from experimentation to adoption at scale. Seventy percent of respondents are beyond experimentation, having deployed AI in selected functions, begun scaling it across the organization, or embedded it enterprise-wide. The shift is notable compared with Creatio’s 2025 research, when 86% of C-level leaders expected AI agents to become important or critical within two to three years. One year later, enterprises are moving from strategic intent to execution. “ The AI conversation has changed dramatically in just one year, ” said Andie Dovgan, Chief Growth Officer at Creatio. “ Enterprises are no longer asking whether AI will matter. The question now is how to redesign the organization so people and AI agents can work together at scale, with the governance, technology and measurement needed to turn AI into business impact. ” Seven findings shaping the next phase of enterprise AI The research highlights seven shifts shaping how enterprises are moving from AI adoption to AI at scale: 1. AI has moved from experimentation to enterprise-wide execution . Seventy percent of organizations are already beyond experimentation, and more than three-quarters expect to scale AI agents across departments or use cases within the next 12 months. 2. AI is reshaping the workforce around augmentation, not replacement . Just 9% expect significant headcount reductions, while 89% expect AI agents to expand workforce capacity, augment teams or create new roles — with nearly twice as many expecting new roles as significant headcount reduction (17% vs. 9%). 3. Deeper AI adopters are 2X more likely to report revenue gains from AI . Organizations automating more than half of their workflows with AI are more than twice as likely to report increased revenue as a positive impact of AI as those automating less than 10%. 4. Only 17% qualify as AI Adoption Leaders — with a distinctly different approach to scale . AI Adoption Leaders automate more workflows with AI, scale agents across departments, embed AI deeply into business operations, establish stronger governance, and measure success against a broader set of business outcomes. 5. Governance is becoming an enabler of AI scale . Organizations with established AI governance are more than 4X as likely to feel very confident scaling AI, positioning governance as a foundation for expansion, not just risk control. 6. description: Explore the new Creatio 10.1 update package.
text: October 14, 2026 Creatio 10.1 Update Package for Creatio Products Explore the new Creatio 10.1 update package. We are pleased to announce that the Creatio 10.1 update package is here! The latest release delivers a wide range of new capabilities and improvements across the Creatio platform, including the improved AI App Development Toolkit, a native WhatsApp channel, deeper sales forecasting, more control over email and campaign delivery, and new administration options for single sign-on and theming. These updates are designed to help organizations accelerate innovation, streamline operations, and maximize productivity. Here is a closer look at what's new in this release. Creatio AI App Development Toolkit . AI agents can now build a larger part of an app from a plain-language request, including the user interface and the analytics around it: Expanded AI coding agent capabilities . You can now ask AI agents to create and manage workplaces and sections, set workplace visibility for roles, build Freedom UI desktops and home pages, add dashboards with charts, list widgets, and comparison or calculated metrics, and manage page-level and object-level business rules. AI-generated pivot tables . Agents can now add pivot tables to dashboards, form pages, list pages, and home pages. They pick the data objects, set row and column groupings, apply count, sum, min, max, and avg aggregates, and add calculated fields, date grouping, and filters. Subtotals and grand totals are applied automatically where supported. Out-of-the-box analytics for generated apps . Apps created with the Toolkit now include section dashboards and an app-level dashboard on the workplace home page. The dashboards are built on the app's data model and are available to all employees. Creatio Sales . Creatio Sales 10.1 provides the following new features and enhancements: Opportunity details in Sales forecasts . You can now click an opportunity name in a forecast metric to open a summary with Summary , Activity , and Timeline tabs. Forecast hierarchies section . Administrators can now list, create, and edit hierarchies in a new section of the Sales Forecasts workplace, without opening a forecast. Before an impactful edit is applied, a warning lists the forecasts it affects. Filters for forecast hierarchies . You can now add filter conditions on source object columns to limit which records a hierarchy includes. The filters are saved with the hierarchy and apply to every forecast that uses it. Configurable forecast submission values . You can now set a reference column for submissions on a forecast column, so each submission uses the latest source value. Live updates in Sales Forecasts . Changes to forecast cells, submissions, or related records now appear for everyone viewing the sheet within about a second, with no refresh and no loss of scroll position. title: What Is CRM: Definition, Benefits & Core CRM Features | Creatio
description: CRM stands for customer relationship management, which is a system for managing all of your company's interactions with current and potential customers.
text: What is CRM? Discover what CRM is, how it works, and how it helps you build stronger customer relationships Try it free Get a demo If you've been wondering what a CRM is and why it matters, you're in the right place. CRM systems have become essential for businesses today, helping organizations of all sizes stay connected with customers, streamline processes, and make data-driven decisions that fuel growth. In this guide, we'll cover everything you need to know about CRM and why it's a must-have for your organization today. What is CRM? CRM Definition What Business Needs CRM Software? Importance How Does a CRM System Work? Benefits Features Who Needs a CRM Solution? Trends FAQ Key takeaways CRM is essential for businesses of all sizes, enabling them to consolidate data and workflows, accelerate growth with insights and collaboration, and standardize complex processes through automation at scale. CRM software is widely used by sales, marketing, service, operations, and management teams to enhance customer relationships, improve workflows, and decision-making. The main benefits of CRM include higher sales, stronger customer retention, centralized data, and cost savings. Modern CRM platforms unify core features with AI and autonomous CRM agents, to help businesses boost efficiency and accelerate growth. Businesses are increasingly adopting new era CRMs, with agentic AI platforms like Creatio helping maximize productivity and deliver smarter customer experiences. CRM Meaning CRM, which is an acronym for Customer Relationship Management, is a system that enables businesses to manage, organize, and automate customer interactions and data throughout the customer lifecycle. The primary goal of a CRM system is to streamline processes, enhance workflows, and strengthen relationships between a business and its customers, ultimately driving revenue and business growth. At its core, CRM provides a single platform where customer and company data is unified, managed, and analyzed, helping teams improve decision-making and deliver consistent experiences across sales, marketing, service, and other departments. What Business Needs CRM Software? Whether you’re a small business, a fast-growing mid-market company, or a large enterprise, a CRM system is the foundation that helps increase revenue by improving sales, service, marketing and operational processes at scale. title: GDPR | Creatio
description: Implementing GDPR policies with Creatio as a step forward in streamlining data
text: Implementing GDPR policies with Creatio as a step forward in streamlining data protection requirements in the EU Creatio provides its customers with control over their content with simple but effective tools. These tools provide Creatio customers with the ability to control their users' access to Creatio, as well as control where their content will be stored (on our cloud service across the EU territory), to ensure its security during transmission and storage (for this purpose, Creatio has implemented HTTPS traffic encryption and solution database encryption). Our company implemented reliable and comprehensive technical and physical control tools designed to prevent unauthorized access to user content or information disclosure. Creatio ensures that our software products used by the Creatio customers to store and process sensitive data allow them to implement the standards of working with confidential data in their organizations in accordance with the Global Data Protection. What is GDPR? The EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) was designed to harmonize data privacy laws across Europe, to protect and empower all EU citizens data privacy and to reshape the way organizations across the region approach data privacy. The regulation replaces the Data Protection Directive 95/46/EC and will be in force May 2018. Creatio's commitment to GDPR readiness Creatio, as a service provider, ensures security and proper processing of confidential data, provided to Creatio by our customers, in compliance with all the requirements of GDPR. Customers shall be independently responsible for processing the personal data of their clients within the context of the agreements for use of Creatio system due to the fact that Creatio has no independent control over such personal data. Creatio shall process the personal data solely on the instructions of its customers within the context of the agreements with them, in line with the purposes and means providedby such customers. We also invariably inform our customers on our privacy and data protection policies, as well as on the methods and technologies used. Read the GDPR compliance guide to learn how Creatio can help your company comply with GDPR requirements.
